title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan: Instrument Class Units and ISO/IEC 17025 Accreditation Scope
content:
Under the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan, one standard calibration consumes a fixed number of calibration units according to the instrument's class, and an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration consumes the class units multiplied by the tier's accredited multiplier. This statement of the lab's scope sets out those figures for every tier.

## Units consumed by one standard calibration, by instrument class

The mapping of instrument class to calibration units is the same on all six tiers (CalCare Pay-Per-Service, CalCare Basic Plan, CalCare Standard Plan, CalCare Accredited Plan, CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan):

| Instrument class | Units per standard calibration | Inside Corbett's ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation scope |
|---|---|---|
| Dimensional gauge | 1 | yes |
| Pressure gauge | 1 | yes |
| Torque tool | 2 | yes |
| Electrical meter | 2 | yes |
| Temperature device | 2 | yes |
| Scale or balance | 3 | yes |
| Gas detector | 2 | no |

The accreditation scope is identical on every tier: dimensional gauges, pressure gauges, torque tools, electrical meters, temperature devices and scales or balances are inside it; gas detectors are not listed in it.

## Accredited multiplier and default certificate, by tier

| Tier | Accredited unit multiplier | Certificate issued when the customer does not ask for another |
|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 2.0 | NIST-traceable |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 2.0 | NIST-traceable |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 2.0 | NIST-traceable |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 1.5 | ISO/IEC 17025 accredited |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 1.5 | ISO/IEC 17025 accredited |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 1.0 | ISO/IEC 17025 accredited |

## Definitions

- **Instrument class units**: mapping instrument class to the calibration units one standard calibration consumes.
- **Accredited unit multiplier**: multiplier on the class units for an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration.
- **Default certificate type**: certificate issued when the customer does not ask for another.
- **Accredited scope classes**: instrument classes inside Corbett's ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation scope.

## Reading the two tables together (hypothetical lookups)

- A scale or balance carries 3 class units on every tier; the multiplier on those units for an accredited calibration is 2.0 on CalCare Basic Plan, 1.5 on CalCare Onsite Plan and 1.0 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- A gas detector carries 2 class units on every tier and is not inside the accreditation scope on any tier.
- A customer of the CalCare Standard Plan who does not ask for another certificate receives a NIST-traceable certificate; a customer of the CalCare Accredited Plan who does not ask for another receives an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited certificate.
